model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the negative log probability scores of the Mistralv0.2-Base model when fine-tuned on six distinct medical specialties—Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics—evaluated against per-specialty terminology. The vertical axis represents “Negative log probability,” ranging from approximately -22 to -27, with lower values indicating better model performance (i.e., higher likelihood). The horizontal axis lists the six specialties, each associated with a group of six bars corresponding to the model’s performance when fine-tuned on each specialty (as indicated by the legend: light blue for Mistralv0.2-Base, and shades of orange and brown for Cardio through Pediatrics). Within each specialty group, the light blue bar (Mistralv0.2-Base) consistently shows the lowest performance (highest negative log probability), while the bar corresponding to the same specialty as the group (e.g., the “Cardio” bar within the “Cardio” group) typically shows the best performance (lowest negative log probability), suggesting that fine-tuning on domain-specific data improves model calibration for that domain. The bars are not sorted by height within groups, and no annotations or error bars are present. The chart visually emphasizes the benefit of fine-tuning by specialty, with performance generally degrading as the fine-tuning specialty diverges from the evaluation specialty.
